Q060.fact_true: A fraction 1/n terminates exactly when n has no prime factors other than 2 and 5.
Q060.fact_false: Of the powers of 2 in this list, 256 is the first one whose decimal digits include a 9.
Q060.method: List the numbers of the form 2^a·5^b in increasing order and find the first one with a 9 in it.

Q061.fact_true: A standard deck has 13 cards in each of 4 suits, and three cards of different suits use 3 of those 4 suits.
Q061.fact_false: Once you choose three different suits, picking one card from each gives 13^3 ways and no further factor is needed.
Q061.method: Count the ways to choose which 3 of the 4 suits are used, then the ways to choose a card within each of those suits, and multiply.

Q062.fact_true: Expanding the left side gives a quadratic in x whose x-coefficient is -(p+q), and the sum of a quadratic's roots is the negative of that coefficient (Vieta's formulas).
Q062.fact_false: By Vieta's formulas, the two roots of this equation sum to pq, so the other root is pq minus r.
Q062.method: Move everything to one side, write the quadratic in standard form, and use the sum of roots with the known root x=r.
